Description & Requirements

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

At Electronic Arts, we exist to Inspire the World to Play. Fan Care powers player support operations, experience management, and workflows that help our global teams to support world-class gaming experiences for millions of players worldwide.

The System Owners team operates at the intersection of enterprise tech, workflow strategy, and functional platform stewardship. We guide internal platforms and support ecosystems through every phase of their lifecycle. This includes leading research, intake, prioritization, requirements definition, and sprint planning to ensure our delivery platform remains modern, scalable, and efficient.

Position Overview

We are looking for an AI Enablement Intern to join the System Owners team within Fan Care for Summer 2027. You will scale and evolve our Agentic AI Framework — a system built to accelerate software delivery, operational workflows, and cross-platform integrations.

While partner engineering teams handle deep architecture, code execution, testing, and deployment, the System Owners team shapes the platform strategy — driving intake, research, functional requirements, and workflow prioritization. As an AI Enablement Intern, you will analyze how our teams work with agentic workflows, identifying functional gaps, and defining platform capabilities that enhance operational efficiency and system effectiveness. Promoting standardized, declarative instruction patterns (such as domain-specific skills.md architectures) will empower additional partners to adapt agentic workflows to their domains.

Responsibilities & Internship Project



- Agentic Framework Solution Enhancement: Define the functional requirements (BRDs, user stories, workflow maps) and operating models for a plug-and-play agentic framework. Help structure standardized skill layers (e.g., modular skills.md configurations) that allow additional teams to customize agent intake, business logic, and persona instructions without altering core code.
- Intake & Discovery: Conduct qualitative research and workflow analysis with our partners (Architecture, Engineering, QA, Fan Care Operations, and Support) to uncover pain points and high-value automation opportunities.
- Feature Backlog & Sprint Planning: Help translate business and operational needs into relevant backlog items for engineering teams building and refining AI agents.
- Enablement & Adoption: Develop documentation, playbooks, and best-practice guides to foster adoption and seamless integration of agentic workflows across Fan Care service delivery teams.
- Impact Measurement: Establish benchmarks to evaluate output accuracy, token efficiency, and productivity gains across different teams adopting the modular agentic framework.

Preferred Qualifications



- Currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s Degree granting program preferrable in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, Human-Computer Interaction, Artificial Intelligence, Product Management or a related field with an anticipated graduation date no earlier than December 2027.
- Conceptual knowledge about Agentic AI architecture (e.g., autonomous agents, tool usage, prompt orchestration, memory models, multi-agent frameworks).
- Familiarity with functional planning and delivery processes (Agile methodologies, user personas, business requirement documents, feature prioritization).
- Curiosity about enterprise software development lifecycles (SDLC), customer experience platforms, and modern IT operations.
- Excellent analytical, problem-solving, collaboration, and verbal/written communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical teams.

Nice-to-Have Skills



- Hands-on experience with LLM frameworks, APIs, or agent builders (e.g., LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, OpenAI APIs, Google Gemini Enterprise).
- Experience with markdown-driven agent prompt architectures, contextual memory management, or RAG systems.
- Familiarity with enterprise workflow tools (Jira, Confluence) and API/integration concepts.

What You'll Learn & Experience



- Direct Impact: Work on a tangible project that directly shapes the next iteration of Fan Care's internal AI tooling.
- Mentorship & Leadership Exposure: Collaborate with experienced System Owners, functional leads, and Fan Care leaders.
- End-to-End Solution Lifecycle: Gain practical experience taking AI features from initial problem discovery and requirements definition through to sprint planning and rollout.
- Gaming Industry Insights: Connect with interns and leaders across Electronic Arts through structured networking, skill-building workshops, and executive speaker series.

About Electronic Arts

We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth.

We adopt a holistic approach to our benefits programs, emphasizing physical, emotional, financial, career, and community wellness to support a balanced life. Our packages are tailored to meet local needs and may include healthcare coverage, mental well-being support, retirement savings, paid time off, family leaves, complimentary games, and more. We nurture environments where our teams can always bring their best to what they do.

Electronic Arts is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will also consider employment qualified applicants with criminal records in accordance with applicable law. EA also makes workplace accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities as required by applicable law.

Todd is the first AI-powered agriculture company designed for sustainable farming, blending agronomy research with technology. We focus on balancing and remineralizing soil, improving surrounding environments and improving health through mineral rich vegetables and fruit. We explore any territory in pursuit of an idea, taking unconventional approaches and making big, bold decisions in unexpected ways. Our internships offer the chance to make a direct impact at Todd and contribute to Todd’s growth journey.


We will win for two reasons:



- There is no other company doing this (yet)
- You can tell the CEO he’s wrong


About the role:


Internships are available remotely in the US within a range of teams from marketing to technology, finance or talent to name a few. You’ll generally be with Todd for 12 weeks and be fully embedded within the team. Our teams are a mix of staff-level college students and tuff 19 yr olds.


Mentorship plays a big role for our interns too — you’ll be paired with one of our senior leaders, providing coaching and support one-to-one throughout the program.


You might be a good fit if you are:



- One of the best [fill in the blank] in the world
- Crazy cracked
- You like what you do
- Down to work for the coolest startup ever


This program does not provide monetary compensation (i.e. no pay) standard. Depending on skill, compensation is an option.


This position does not support work authorization/visa sponsorship.

Description & Requirements

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

We Are EA

At Electronic Arts, we create experiences that inspire players and communities around the world. Making great games is challenging, and it takes creative, curious, and passionate people working together to make those experiences possible.

EA Digital Platform : Gameplay Services

The EA Digital Platform provides shared technology and services that help game teams tap into the power of the global EA ecosystem. By building reusable capabilities that can be integrated across games, we enable our studios to focus on what they do best, creating incredible experiences for players.

Within Gameplay Services, we build and operate online capabilities used across EA games, including Stats & Leaderboards.

The Challenge Ahead

Stats & Leaderboards touches player experiences across EA's portfolio. Our technology helps games capture player statistics, track progress and accomplishments, compare players and friends, and power leaderboard experiences.

Behind those experiences are highly available, distributed backend systems designed to process and serve player data at scale.

As a Software Engineer Intern, you'll work alongside experienced engineers to build and improve these production services. You'll get hands-on experience solving real engineering problems while contributing to software that improves player experiences across EA games. You will report to a Technical Director on the team.

What You'll Do



- Design and implement backend features using Java and Spring Boot.
- Build and evolve service interfaces using gRPC and Protocol Buffers.
- Work with PostgreSQL and Redis to store, retrieve, and process player statistics and leaderboard data.
- Develop and run services in a Kubernetes-based environment.
- Write production-quality code along with unit and integration tests.
- Investigate and debug issues using logs, metrics, traces, and other observability tools.
- Learn how we design and optimize distributed systems for performance, scalability, reliability, and availability.
- Participate in code reviews and technical design discussions with experienced engineers.
- Collaborate with engineers across Gameplay Services and EA game teams.
- Participate in the team's sprint cycle, including stand-ups, sprint planning, backlog refinement, demos, and retrospectives.
- Own a well-scoped engineering project or feature from design and implementation through testing and delivery.

What We're Looking For



- Pursuing a bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field.
- Programming experience with Java and an understanding of object-oriented programming.
- Understanding of core computer science concepts including data structures, algorithms, concurrency, and databases.
- Curiosity about how large-scale systems work.
- A player- and customer-focused mindset—you think about how the technology you build ultimately affects the people using it.

Exposure To Any Of The Following



- Spring / Spring Boot
- gRPC and Protocol Buffers
- PostgreSQL or other relational databases
- Redis or other caching technologies
- Docker and Kubernetes
- Microservices or distributed systems
- Cloud technologies
- Automated testing and CI/CD
- Performance testing, profiling, or optimization

What You'll Learn

You'll experience the full software development lifecycle on a production engineering team—from understanding requirements and participating in technical design to implementation, testing, deployment, monitoring, and iteration.

You'll gain practical experience with Java, Spring Boot, gRPC, PostgreSQL, Redis, and Kubernetes while learning how distributed backend services are built and operated at EA scale.

Through mentorship, code reviews, design discussions, and hands-on development, you'll learn from experienced engineers while gradually taking greater ownership of your work.

Most importantly, you'll ship meaningful software that contributes to player experiences across EA's games.

You must be available for a full-time paid internship in the summer of 2026.

At this time, we are considering Bachelor's students who will be enrolled in an accredited degree program in the summer of 2027, slated to graduate no earlier than December 2027. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in Canada on a full-time basis during the 16-week internship. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

Please ensure that your graduation date is visible on your resume.

Pay Transparency - North America



-  British Columbia (depending on location e.g. Vancouver vs. Victoria) *$65,000 - $70,000 CAD

Pay is just one part of the overall compensation at EA.

We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth.
